subject.title: [Bug] "Cannot convert undefined or null to object" in 2026.3.2 with google-vertex/gemini-3.1-pro-preview

question: Should this issue remain the canonical tracker for both the sanitizer and native Vertex ADC/gaxios paths, or should maintainers split the auth-stack dependency path into a separate canonical issue before closing anything?
rationale: The sanitizer fix is a narrow open PR, but the latest-release service-account ADC reproduction and dependency/auth-stack evidence require maintainer intent on tracking scope and proof sufficiency before cleanup can safely close the issue.

options.title: Keep one canonical issue
options.body: Keep this issue open until both the sanitizer slice and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios slice have live proof or an explicit maintainer proof override.

options.title: Split the auth-stack path
options.body: Move the service-account ADC/gaxios/node-fetch/domexception failure into a focused follow-up and allow this issue to close only after the sanitizer slice lands and is verified.

options.title: Accept sanitizer-only scope
options.body: A provider owner can declare this issue scoped only to sanitizer behavior, but should preserve the latest-release ADC reproduction in another linked item first.

recommendation.title: Keep one canonical issue
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until both the sanitizer slice and the native Vertex ADC/gaxios slice have live proof or an explicit maintainer proof override.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice crosses Plugin SDK helper ownership, provider auth behavior, dependency policy, and canonical issue triage.
